list.footer: Send and receive AIS over the internet via the AISCast protocol.

item_fields.label: Name
item_fields.desc: What you call this server. Leave it empty to show the address.

item_fields.label: Address
item_fields.desc: The AIS relay to connect to.

item_fields.label: Port
item_fields.desc: The relay streams over TLS on port 443.

item_fields.label: Share AIS
item_fields.desc: Send everything heard by the AIS receiver on a connected NMEA network back to the relay, this boat's own transponder reports included, so others see it too. Feeding earns higher limits.

item_fields.label: Token
item_fields.desc: An access token from the relay. Leave it empty to use an identity minted automatically.

item_fields.label: On
item_fields.desc: Off closes the stream and stops reconnecting.
